'''Erkon the Vile''' was an infamous [[Pirate/Legends|space pirate]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] Erkon was spotted in the [[Karthakk system]], piloting a [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]].
